Policy Name: Require a minimum number of reviewers
Description: Requires a minimum number of approving reviews on a pull request before it can be merged into a matching branch.

Policy Name: Dismiss stale reviews on new push
Description: Automatically dismisses existing pull request approvals when new, reviewable commits are pushed to the source branch.
Requires an approving review from a designated code owner for pull requests that modify files with a CODEOWNERS entry.

Policy Name: Require approval of most recent push
Description: Requires that the most recent reviewable push be approved by someone other than the person who pushed it (equivalent to ADO's 'prohibit most recent pusher from approving').
Requires that all review comment threads on a pull request be marked resolved before it can be merged.
Restricts which merge methods (merge commit, squash, rebase) are allowed when completing a pull request.

Policy Name: Require status checks to pass before merging
Description: Requires one or more status checks (CI builds or external services) to pass before a pull request can be merged. Update the 'context' names to match your GitHub Actions/CI check names.
Requires that all commits pushed to matching branches have verified signatures.
Prevents merge commits from being pushed to matching branches, enforcing squash or rebase merges only.
Prevents users with push access from force-pushing to matching branches.
Only allows users with bypass permission to delete matching branches.

Policy Name: Require deployments to succeed before merging
Description: Requires that changes be successfully deployed to specified environments before a pull request can be merged. Update 'required_deployment_environments' with your environment names.
Blocks pushes that add or modify files/paths matching the specified fnmatch patterns (equivalent to ADO's File path validation).
Blocks pushes containing file paths that exceed the specified character limit (equivalent to ADO's Maximum path length).
Blocks pushes containing files with the specified extensions.
Blocks pushes containing individual files larger than the specified size in megabytes (equivalent to ADO's Maximum file size).
Blocks pushes containing commits whose author email does not match the configured pattern (equivalent to ADO's Commit author email validation). Update 'pattern' to your organization's domain.
Blocks pushes containing commit messages that do/don't match the configured pattern. Not present in ADO; optional extra GitHub-only control.
Blocks creation of branches whose name does/doesn't match the configured pattern. Not present in ADO; optional extra GitHub-only control.
Blocks creation of tags whose name does/doesn't match the configured pattern. Not present in ADO; optional extra GitHub-only control.
